githubToken.description: Optional GitHub personal access token. Mark this field as Secret when pasting. Increases the API rate limit from 60 requests/hour (unauthenticated) to 5000 requests/hour. A classic token with 'public_repo' scope is enough for public repositories.
githubToken.title: GitHub personal access token (optional)

includeReadme.description: Fetch and include the decoded README text for each repository (capped at 500 KB).
includeReadme.title: Include README

maxResults.description: Hard cap on the number of repositories to return. GitHub's search API itself is capped at 1000 results; direct mode is only limited by this value.
maxResults.title: Maximum results

mode.description: Choose 'search' to query GitHub's search API with a keyword / qualifier expression, or 'direct' to fetch a known list of repository URLs.
mode.title: Mode

repositoryUrls.description: List of full GitHub repository URLs to scrape (used when mode = direct). Accepts https://github.com/owner/repo, ending with .git, trailing slash, or the git@github.com:owner/repo.git SSH form.
repositoryUrls.title: Repository URLs

searchQuery.description: GitHub search query (used when mode = search). Supports qualifiers like 'stars:>1000', 'language:python', 'topic:llm', 'user:apify'. See GitHub's search syntax docs for the full grammar.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order for search results. Ignored in direct mode.
sortBy.title: Sort results by
